name: Louis Reed
source:
The eldest brother of the Reed family.

As the successor of the Reed family, Louis undertook various special educations. However, he ended up gaining independence and not succeeding the house. Quick-witted and ntelligent from a young age, he also fairly excels in swordplay. Even so, he's often severe with words and conduct, and isn't good at being a leader. He also isn't good at communicating with his brothers.

After he gave away his positions as the commander of the chivalric order and the head of the Reed family to Adel, Louis started up a foreign trade business and achieved success. Since he had to collect information and find patronesses in the high society he loathes in order to start up his business, he has experience with women. At present, he's still involved in the world of those high up on the social ladder. However, since he's only there in order to collect information, he doesn't get involved with the women.

His interests are classical music and opera appreciation, as well as collecting furniture and ornaments from the Orient. He does his absolute best to hide his interests from others, but when a topic in regards to them is brought up, he can't help himself from becoming talkative about them.
